description: This file defines a React component named WsStatusPage that displays the current WebSocket connection status, last status event, and provides a connect button. It imports React hooks, a PageShell component, and application context via useApp, indicating it renders part of a web application's user interface for WebSocket status monitoring.

methods.name: statusTone(status)
methods.description: A helper function that returns styling info based on the WebSocket status string ('open', 'connecting', 'error', 'closed').

methods.name: WsStatusPage()
